comment: Golden vectors for broadcast/next-airing resolution. Convention: RFC5545 rule 'R/<start>/P7D' emits occurrences every 7 days from the <start> instant (exact UTC arithmetic, weekday-agnostic). The expected value is the FIRST occurrence strictly after nowLocalISO, then re-expressed in the same wall-clock timezone offset as nowLocalISO. All expected values were computed explicitly in UTC then written down. All data is synthetic.

vectors.name: weekly-rfc5545-utc
vectors.note: UTC start 13:00:22Z -> next Wed-cycle after ref (UTC 2026-07-19T16:00:00Z) is 2026-07-22T13:00:22Z, rendered in the reference timezone +08:00.

vectors.name: movie-begin-only-no-broadcast
vectors.note: No broadcast rule: treat begin as a one-shot airing. 2026-09-12T10:30:00Z converted to +08:00.

vectors.name: fallback-to-site-ani-one
vectors.note: Item has no begin/broadcast; selected site ani_one (present in preferredSites) supplies the rule. Next 7-day occurrence after ref is 2026-07-22T21:00:00+08:00.

vectors.name: cross-year-boundary
vectors.note: Reference UTC 2026-12-30T16:00:00Z is after the first occurrence; next cycle is 2027-01-06T15:00:00Z which crosses the year, rendered +08:00.

vectors.name: begin-with-milliseconds
vectors.note: Sub-second milliseconds preserved through the 7-day arithmetic: 2026-07-22T13:00:22.480Z -> +08:00.

vectors.name: begin-non-utc-offset-jst
vectors.note: Start given in +09:00 (JST) = 13:00Z; next cycle 2026-07-22T13:00:00Z re-expressed in reference tz +08:00.
